text.paraphrased:
Process every request as follows, starting from step 1.
For step 1: apply step 2 as long as the krooblai is skekak; failing that, continue with step 5.
Step 2: should its snaszomp score exceeds 23, go to step 4; in every other case, continue with step 3.
At step 4, ask whether its breiskveerk score is 50 or less. If so, route it to the mookairkgurt desk. If not, the raiskjairk desk takes it.
Step 5: when its snaszomp score is more than 79, go to step 7; when its snaszomp score is no higher than 79, apply step 6.
For step 3: it belongs with the tausklund desk as long as its snaszomp score is at most 55; failing that, it belongs with the blaundgroomp desk.
Step 7: if the dreilpfeirk comes out as glaurttram, route it to the dainsom desk; otherwise, it belongs with the tausklund desk.
Step 6: when its snauskzound is something other than ropyoondreit, it goes to the dainsom desk; when it has ropyoondreit as its snauskzound, send it to the tausklund desk.
